description: This Java class, EcuDefinitionHandler, is a SAX parser handler for XML files defining ECUs (Electronic Control Units). It processes XML elements related to ECU definitions, extracting attributes like IDs, years, makes, models, transmission types, and other ECU-specific data, and stores these in a map for further use within the project.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionHandler
classes.description: A SAX DefaultHandler subclass that parses ECU definitions from an XML file, extracting relevant ECU information and storing it in a map.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes the ECU definition map at the start of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, resetting or setting relevant ECU attribute variables.

methods.name: characters
methods.description: Collects character data inside XML elements into a buffer.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Processes completed XML elements, extracting accumulated character data and storing ECU definitions when appropriate.

methods.name: getEcuDefinitionMap
methods.description: Returns the map of ECU definitions parsed from the XML.

methods.name: romDetail
methods.description: Generates a detailed string summary of the current ECU record for debugging.
